statement: Three general conics in the complex affine plane admit exactly 184 tangent circles. Circles are represented projectively by conics passing through the two circular points at infinity; the count is computed in the space of complete conics and counts geometric circles rather than redundant contact coordinates.

notes: Generic geometric circles; not the naive degree of the nine-equation incidence system.
